title: Indigo (Chapter 5)
subject: English
description: "Indigo" by Louis Fischer (Chapter 5, Class 12 Flamingo) is an excerpt from Fischer's book The Life of Mahatma Gandhi. It chronicles Mahatma Gandhi's first civil disobedience movement in India at Champaran, Bihar, in 1917. The presentation explains the historical background, key events, themes, important characters, literary significance, and examination-oriented points in a concise and student-friendly manner.
